name: norregel v1
description: This record preregisters norregel v1, a closed benchmark that asks language models for numeric values in Norwegian statutes, regulations and parliamentary decisions as they applied on a stated date. The values are amounts in NOK, percentage rates, multiples of the National Insurance basic amount (G) and age limits. The record contains four files. PREREG.md (in Norwegian) gives the research questions, hypotheses, build rules, cleanness rule and analysis plan. PREREG_TILLEGG.md (in English) is a dated addendum, written before any model run, that fixes the exclusions, the primary scorer, the run configuration and the exact tests; where the two documents differ, the addendum applies. LOCK_MANIFEST.md gives SHA-256 checksums for the locked files and the source data. exclusions_tillegg.json lists the excluded and eligible item ids, without answer values. Source data. Answer values and value histories were extracted mechanically, without a language model, from Lovdata's open data. The sources are Norsk Lovtidend, section 1 (2001–2026), and the current consolidated statutes and central regulations, retrieved from https://api.lovdata.no/v1/publicData on 9 October 2026 under the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0. Design. The unit is the year item: one question per provision per period of validity. The locked set has 916 items in 97 series. Of these, 462 are in Bokmål and 454 in Nynorsk, assigned per series with seed 20261016.
